notes.notes:

notes.title: A Better Experience! v1.1
notes.notes:
Hello, adventurers!

We analyzed lots of players to update Dogu the Adventurer for a better experience!
From auto-aiming to chopping trees, v1.1 update contains various additions, improvements and fixes!

[h1]BETTER CONTROLS![/h1]

[list]
[*] Gamepad auto-aim!
[*] Added airship control scheme to the airship interface.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194610/10fc5bf472f9b1a191ee374e2b16083d135c0f54.png[/img]

[h1]BETTER INTERACTIONS![/h1]

[list]
[*] You can break crates & barrels for loot now!
[*] Some people tried to chop trees... So, why not!
[*] Some people tried to break stones... So, you still can't.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194610/88370fddfa41f5c3e6c016a6f215f91f4e0e65e4.gif[/img]

[h1]BETTER AIR BATTLES![/h1]

[list]
[*] Rebalanced the enemy balloons, towers and flying bosses.
[*] Rebalanced the Tree World (5th world).
[/list]

[h1]BETTER FIXES![/h1]

[list]
[*] Improved the collision between camera and buildings.
[*] Added more autosaves to Ringworld (2nd world).
[*] Fixed the player was getting stuck after getting hit while dashing or using bow.
[*] Fixed choice selection in dialogues.
[/list]

Have a nice adventure!
Ashina Studios

notes.title: The Beginning of the Adventure!
notes.notes:
Hello adventurers!

We continuously updated our game since the release. Thanks to everyone who played the game on the release and helped us to make Dogu the Adventurer better!

Here are the summary of latest changes:
[list]
[*]Added more hints to Breeze Islands (1st world)
[*]Added more blacksmiths to Desert World (4th world)
[*]Added the compass key to HUD for more clarity
[*]Fixed bow auto-aiming to wrong object
[*]Fixed some balloon bugs
[*]Fixed some issues with quests of the Breeze Islands (1st world)
[*]Fixed some NPC visual issues of the Ring World (2nd world)
[*]Fixed the engineer pig quest of the Snowy World (3th world)
[*]Fixed a barrier problem in Lava World (6th world)
[*]Fixed some issues with final boss level
[*]Improved the collisions of Lv2 & Lv3 balloons
[*]Improved the enemy balloon ai
[*]Improved the options screen
[*]Balanced the snow golems in Snowy World (3th world)
[*]Balanced the final boss
[*]Balanced the bandits
[/list]
and lots of more...

Have a nice adventure!
Ashina Studios
